"Are you fond of dogs?" asked the prince. She nodded. Why was it already so hot? "Am I going to be blessed with the
pleasure of hearing your voice, or have you resolved to be silent for the duration of our journey?"

"I'm afraid your questions didn't merit a verbal response."

Dorian bowed low. "Then I apologize, my lady! How terrible it must be to condescend to answer! Next time, I'll try to
think of something more stimulating to say." With that, he turned on his heel and strode away, his dogs trailing after
him.
